source_snapshot.criteria: Each transition trains to the expected speed and width with no errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.

old_problem: The proprietary Speed Change 12 artifact, path/topology, Gen1 establishment method, expected width, Gen2 settle deadline and allowed transient/error deltas are absent; a final Gen2 snapshot cannot prove all five hundred transitions.
disposition_reason: The source defines an unambiguous direction and count: Gen1 to Gen2, five hundred times, full expected width and no disqualifying errors. Missing LTSSM/NVQual configuration, physical path and timing/error limits are bindable Project Configuration under ED-14/15/19. The review therefore resolves Pending while leaving execution gate-closed and requiring an atomic per-transition ledger with a first-fault stop.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2101, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2102 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00024-V002 / 9172f03b9f4df95c was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 12 explicitly covers Gen1-to-Gen2 and remains distinct from next-row Speed Change 13 Gen1-to-Gen3; results or control primitives are not shared without signed equivalence.
The exact NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual build/configuration is a required package; it must identify how Gen1 is established and Gen2 requested on the mapped path.
Bind root port, switch/retimer, endpoint/GPU, lanes and expected width, then capture requested state, LTSSM transition, negotiated Gen2/full-width state and error deltas inside every iteration.
Five hundred complete unique transactions are required; startup, incomplete/missing records and recovery/retry actions do not count.
Stop before releasing the next request on late/failed Gen2 settle, width reduction, endpoint loss, new disqualifying AER, reset, logging gap or thermal/power/health anomaly.
Preserve baseline and first-failure evidence without clearing errors or automatically replaying the transition; only signed recovery may restore the path.
No LTSSM/NVQual, speed change, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Speed Change 12: 500 atomic Gen1-to-Gen2 PCIe transitions
test_case.purpose: Prove the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path performs five hundred complete Gen1-to-Gen2 transitions, reaching the required Gen2 width within deadline each time without disqualifying link or platform errors.
required_package: Pinned owner-approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 12 package, command and configuration
Approved Gen1 setup, Gen2 request, expected width, LTSSM sequence, settle deadline and transient allowance
Permitted AER/error deltas and atomic ledger definition for exactly 500 transactions
Dedicated SUT/window, console, stable power/cooling, abort interlock and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is bound. Preserve full topology/link/AER/kernel/BMC/GPU baselines; after point approval run the exact Speed Change 12 recipe with ledger entries 1..500. Within each entry record Gen1 establishment, Gen2 request, LTSSM/timestamps, settled negotiated speed/width, endpoint presence, error deltas and health before permitting the next transition. Stop on first failure or evidence gap; do not clear errors, replace a transaction or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: All 500 numbered transactions begin from the approved Gen1 state and settle at Gen2 with the signed full width inside the deadline; the endpoint and required siblings remain enumerated, no disqualifying new error/reset/health event occurs, and final topology/link health matches the approved state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until recipe, path and numeric/time/error oracle are approved. Thereafter PASS requires 500 complete accepted ledger entries with Gen2/full-width settlement and clean correlated health. FAIL at the first late/wrong speed, width reduction, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Package/configuration/evidence absence is BLOCKED; a rerun cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until tool/config, path identity, settle/error rules, 500-count policy, aborts and recovery are signed.
Use a dedicated approved SUT with stable power/cooling, console recovery and immediate point authorization.
Preserve counters/logs and durably accept each transition before the next request.
Interlock and stop without retry on the first ambiguous/failed transition, link/device loss, error, reset or safety anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, Speed Change 12 build/configuration and approval
Mapped PCIe hierarchy/lanes plus signed Gen1/Gen2/full-width/LTSSM/deadline/error contract
Atomic ledger 1..500 with requested and negotiated states, width, LTSSM, timestamps and raw result
Per-transition AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and artifact/gap audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final topology/link/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On first failed/late settle, downtrain, endpoint/sibling loss, disqualifying error, reset or evidence gap, inhibit later transitions and preserve the transaction. Do not switch to Speed Change 13 or replay it. Use only the approved recovery and quarantine the path if full topology and health are not restored.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently specifies Gen1-to-Gen2 and 500 transitions; missing operational inputs are project configuration rather than conflict.

blocked.reason: Static method and safety/acceptance structure are complete; execution can be blocked later by unavailable proprietary artifacts or bindings.
